digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler bridge and legacy exit-code adapter
propositions: Canonical preview/sync operations must emit only exit codes 0/1/2 (success, failure, invalid) while benign dispositions map to exit 0.

Legacy reconcile CLI and direct-engine routes must retain historical exit code translations (3 for live pass, 4 for phase gate, 75 for reschedule) with their original messages and defaults for backward compatibility.
A single typed _Disposition representation must be consumed by both canonical and legacy adapters with separate translation logic at the outer adapter boundary without divergent whitelists.
Production workflows must use only the canonical 0/1/2 contract with no legacy case whitelist, while paused state preserves the commit-skip behavior.
No production automation (systemd units, Jenkins, scripts, workflows) outside compatibility tests must depend on legacy exit codes 3/4/75.
